line: Namaskara Bengaluru! Manju here... traffic update, quick one.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Bright opener; small breath before 'traffic update'.

line: Hello hello hello. RJ Manju. Ond nimisha, traffic nodona.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Playful triple hello, then casual.

line: Aaand we're back. Manju here. Roads hegide? Let's see.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Stretch 'Aaand'; 'Roads hegide?' as a real question.

line: Uff. Peak hour, guru. Outer Ring Road... full jam. Bumper to bumper.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Tired sigh on 'Uff'. Pause after 'Outer Ring Road'.

line: Office time. Everybody is on the road, nobody is moving. Adjust maadi.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Dry, amused.

line: Signal alli full line ide. Patience, patience. Horn beda, please.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Gentle scolding on 'Horn beda'.

line: Roads are free right now. Sakkath time to ride.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Upbeat.

line: No jam, no tension. Arre, is this even Bengaluru?
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Mock surprise on the question.

line: Traffic is okay-okay. Swalpa slow near the signals, ashte.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Shrugging, matter of fact.

line: Late aagide. Roads are khaali... only the street dogs are on duty.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Softer, late-night voice; smile on the dogs.

line: Empty roads, but signal jump maadbedi. Police mama is still awake.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Low, teasing warning.

line: Male bartha ide! Roads are slippery, brake slowly, okay?
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Excited on 'Male bartha ide', then caring.

line: Rain, guru. Potholes are swimming pools now. Nodkondu hogi.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Wry.

line: One bus has broken down, one lane is blocked. Swalpa adjust maadi.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. News voice, then friendly. No road name: the screen shows it.

line: Road dug up again... pipe work, as usual. Bere route thogoli.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Weary 'as usual'.

line: Wedding procession on the road, band and all. Slow hogi... and wish the couple!
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Happy; respectful about the wedding.

line: One bull is standing in the middle of the road. Full relaxed. Horn maadbedi, just go around.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Fond, unhurried.

line: Helmet haakoli, signal follow maadi. Back to the music.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Sign-off, falling tone.

line: Ashte from me. Ride safe, Bengaluru.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Warm.

line: Okay, bye bye. More music, less horn.
emotion/notes: Radio RJ, warm and quick, smiling. Light, quick.

line: Vehicle beka? GaadiGo! Scooter, cycle, even a van... on rent, by the hour. GaadiGo: neevu ride maadi, tension namge.
emotion/notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up.

line: Minchu E-One. Electric scooter. Goes like lightning, drinks nothing. Minchu: current alli future.
emotion/notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up.

line: Swarna Mahal Jewellers. This wedding season, making charges... fifty percent off. Namma mane, namma chinna.
emotion/notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up. Rich, slower.

line: Hungry at midnight? Crispy Coop, open till two. Ondu bite, full delight.
emotion/notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up.

line: Filter House coffee. Slow decoction, steel tumbler, bisi bisi. Kaapi first, everything next.
emotion/notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up. Cosy.

line: Sampige Residency. Two and three BHK. Five minutes from everywhere... according to our brochure.
emotion/notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up. Deadpan on the last part.

line: Stride Shoe Company. Buy two pairs, third pair for ajji, free. Hejje hejje comfort.
emotion/notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up.

line: Riders beku! Join Deliver It. Weekly payout, flexible hours, yellow jacket. Bega, jopana, on time.
emotion/notes: Radio ad read by the RJ: faster, sales voice, slogan slower. Every brand is made up.

line: Ey! Yen aaythu? You okay?
emotion/notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English. Worried.

line: Ayyo, jopana maga! Order nodu, is it fine?
emotion/notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English.

line: Gaadi kettoytha? Call the mechanic... or take a GaadiGo.
emotion/notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English. Practical.

line: Sari, rest maadu. Naale sigona.
emotion/notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English. Kind.

line: Okay maga, offline. Oota maadu.
emotion/notes: On the phone, friendly dispatcher, late 30s, Bengaluru Kannada-English.

line: Hello! Delivery? Gate ge banni first.
emotion/notes: Apartment security guard at a gate, 50s, polite and routine. Calling across.

line: Delivery? OTP heli.
emotion/notes: Apartment security guard at a gate, 50s, polite and routine.

line: Sari, it matches. Register alli sign maadi.
emotion/notes: Apartment security guard at a gate, 50s, polite and routine.

line: Okay, hogi. Vehicle stays outside the gate.
emotion/notes: Apartment security guard at a gate, 50s, polite and routine.

line: Order ready. Jopana, maga!
emotion/notes: Dark store counter staff, young, busy.

line: Tagoli. Bega hogi.
emotion/notes: Dark store counter staff, young, busy.

line: Banni banni, Deliver It anna! Chai beka?
emotion/notes: Chai stall owner, 40s, cheerful, loud over the stove. Calling a regular over.

line: Yen samachara, guru? Bisi chai ready ide.
emotion/notes: Chai stall owner, 40s, cheerful. Easy, familiar.

line: Tagoli, bisi bisi cutting chai. Swalpa rest maadi, aamele hogi.
emotion/notes: Chai stall owner. Handing over the glass; kindly.

line: Special chai, shunti haakidini. Kudidre full charge!
emotion/notes: Chai stall owner. Proud of his chai; a grin on 'full charge'.

line: Duddu illva? Parvagilla, guru. Ivattu nanna kade inda. Naale kodi.
emotion/notes: Chai stall owner. Warm, waving the money away. Not pitying.

line: Outer Ring Road full jam, guru. Agara signal hatra hogbedi. Olagina cross-galalli hogi.
emotion/notes: Chai stall owner. Leaning in, sharing what every customer has told him.

line: Customers heltidru: alli road block aagide. Bere daari nodi.
emotion/notes: Chai stall owner. Matter of fact, pointing down the road.

line: Ivattu road-u free ide. Aaramagi hogi, maga.
emotion/notes: Chai stall owner. Relaxed.

line: Sari, jopana hogi. Matte banni!
emotion/notes: Chai stall owner. Calling after a regular.

line: Namaskara. Delivery idya? Illa andre gate hatra gaadi nillisbedi.
emotion/notes: Apartment security guard at a gate, 50s, polite and routine. Doesn't know this rider yet.

line: Oho, namma Deliver It huduga! Banni banni. Ivattu yaav flat-ge?
emotion/notes: The same guard, now a friend: he has seen this rider three times. Pleased to see him. The rider's name is shown on screen before the line.

line: Register nodtini... haan, illi ide. Ishtu sala bandiddira.
emotion/notes: Security guard. Running a finger down the visitors' register. The number is shown on screen.

line: Tagoli, neeru kudiri. Bisilu jaasti ide ivattu.
emotion/notes: Security guard. Kindly, handing over a steel tumbler.

line: Sari, jopana hogi.
emotion/notes: Security guard. A nod.

line: Yen guru, order sikta? Naanu ardha ghante inda wait maadtidini.
emotion/notes: Delivery rider, 20s, leaning on his bike outside the dark store. Tired but friendly.

line: Banni, banni. Ivattu orders kammi, time jaasti.
emotion/notes: Delivery rider, 20s. Dry humour.

line: Order ide alva, guru? Illi yaake nintidiya? Hogu, customer kaaytidare!
emotion/notes: Delivery rider, 20s. Shooing a friend along, laughing.

line: Race nadeetide, guru! Maathu aamele. Odu, odu!
emotion/notes: Delivery rider. Shouting, pointing down the road.

line: Iga surge nadeetide, guru. Online-alle iru: prathi order-ge extra duddu. Aadre Agara signal full jam.
emotion/notes: Delivery rider. Keen: this is the hour the money is made.

line: Group-alli message bantu: alli road block aagide. Aa kade hogbeda.
emotion/notes: Delivery rider. Reading it off his phone.

line: Ivattu road-u khaali, guru. Yaav daari aadru sari.
emotion/notes: Delivery rider. Relaxed, a shrug.

line: Gottha? Sector 2 aunty ₹50 tip kottru. Bari ondu packet haalu-ge!
emotion/notes: Delivery rider. Delighted, can't believe it.

line: Ravi sir ivattu full tension. Surge time-alli yaaru offline hogbaardu anthe.
emotion/notes: Delivery rider. Lowered voice, amused.

line: Ninne ondu cake order. Speed breaker mele full smash. One star, guru.
emotion/notes: Delivery rider. Rueful, laughing at himself.

line: One-way nodkond hogu. Illa andre full suttu barbeku.
emotion/notes: Delivery rider. Practical advice to a newer rider.

line: Society gate-alli OTP ready itko. Guard sir-ge kaayisbeda.
emotion/notes: Delivery rider. Practical.

line: Cake, ice cream idre speed breaker-alli slow. Customer rating adralle ide.
emotion/notes: Delivery rider. Speaks from experience.

line: Race beka? Illinda alli varegu, time olage. Geddre chai nanna kade inda!
emotion/notes: Delivery rider. Grinning, a dare. The place and the time are shown on screen.

line: Ready? Hogu, hogu, hogu!
emotion/notes: Delivery rider. Shouting him off.

line: Super, guru! Sakkath riding. Tagoli, chai kudi.
emotion/notes: Delivery rider, on the phone afterwards. Impressed.

line: Aiyo, swalpa late. Next time, maga.
emotion/notes: Delivery rider, on the phone afterwards. Friendly, no gloating.

line: Sari guru, sigona. Jopana.
emotion/notes: Delivery rider. Casual.

line: Excuse me, thamma... ee jaaga yelli barutte? Naanu daari tappi hogidini.
emotion/notes: A woman in her 50s in a saree, a little flustered, polite. The place's name is shown on screen.

line: Tumba thanks, thamma. Nidhaanavaagi hogi, aaytha?
emotion/notes: Aunty. Relieved; firm on 'ride slowly'.

line: Sari sari, artha aaytu. Thanks kanappa.
emotion/notes: Aunty. Repeating the directions to herself.

line: Parvagilla, kelsa nodi. Hogi banni.
emotion/notes: Aunty. Understanding, not put out.

line: Illi saaku, thamma. Devaru olledu maadli! Idu itko, chai-ge.
emotion/notes: Aunty, getting down. Warm; presses a note into his hand.

line: Yen guru! Kannu kaansalva? Nanna auto-ge touch maadidya!
emotion/notes: Auto driver, 40s, out of his auto in a flash. Loud and theatrical, never threatening: this is street comedy.

line: Nodi, nodi! Scratch aagide. Yaaru kodtare idakke?
emotion/notes: Auto driver. Pointing at a scratch that may be ten years old.

line: Naana? Naanu indicator haakidde! Meter illa, aadre indicator ide!
emotion/notes: Auto driver. Outraged innocence; the joke is on himself.

line: Hmm. Sari, bidu. Next time nodkond odsu, maga.
emotion/notes: Auto driver. Deflating; he never wanted a fight.

line: Aa, sari. Nee olle huduga. Hogi baa.
emotion/notes: Auto driver. Pocketing the note, all smiles.

line: Police-a? ...Beda, beda. Hogu, hogu. Time waste.
emotion/notes: Auto driver. A beat of alarm, then a hasty retreat.

line: Yenri! Nodkond hogi!
emotion/notes: Someone crossing the road, cut close by a scooter. Startled, indignant.

line: Aiyo! Swalpa nidhaana, guru!
emotion/notes: Someone crossing the road. Startled.

line: Yen avasara nimge? Jana idare illi!
emotion/notes: Someone crossing the road. Scolding, an elder's tone.

line: Thanks, anna!
emotion/notes: Someone the rider stopped for, crossing with a hand raised. Pleased.

line: Olledu, thamma. Hogi banni.
emotion/notes: An older person the rider stopped for. Warm.

line: Delivery anna!
emotion/notes: Called across the street to a passing delivery rider. Friendly, sing-song.

line: Oye, Deliver It! Nanna order yelli?
emotion/notes: A joker on the footpath, calling after a delivery rider. Teasing.

line: Delivery anna, swalpa fast!
emotion/notes: Called after a passing rider, laughing: what every customer says.

line: Footpath-u gaadi-ge alla!
emotion/notes: Someone stepping back from a scooter on the footpath. Cross.

line: Idu road alla, guru!
emotion/notes: Someone stepping back from a scooter on the footpath. Exasperated.
